fileNameDisplay.tip: Edits the name of the currently opened file

confirm.title: Confirm file upload
confirm.message: Are you sure you want to upload a new file? This will replace the current file.

success.title: File closed
success.message: The file has been successfully closed.

confirm.title: Confirm file closure
confirm.message: Are you sure you want to close the current file? Any unsaved changes will be lost.

confirmMultiple.title: Confirm file closure
confirmMultiple.message: Are you sure you want to close file? Any unsaved changes will be lost.

tip.resetZoom: Resets the zoom level to 100% and center image

classicMode.title: Classic Zoom Mode
classicMode.text: In this mode, 100% zoom means the entire image fits within the visible area without cropping.

physicalMode.title: Physical Size Mode
physicalMode.text: In this mode, 100% zoom represents the real physical size of the image on your screen — for example, 10 cm on screen equals 10 cm in reality. Use calibration to ensure accurate scaling on your monitor.

physicalContentSize.tip: Set the desired real-world width in centimeters. Double-click the icon to reset to default.

calibrateButton.tip: Start calibration to match on-screen measurements with real-world centimeters.

helpButton.tip: Shows or hides the help overlay

settingsButton.tip: Opens or closes the settings panel

button.tip: Toggles between light and dark mode
